Population.evidence_source: Our data are drawn from a qualitative study of 14 cases of completed suicide conducted in 2008e9 (Owens et al., 2009, 2011). The deceased were identified by examination of HM Coroners' case files in London, Southwest England and SouthWales. Inclusion criteria were age 18e34, with a verdict of suicide (open verdicts were excluded because suicidal intention may have been unclear) and not in contact with mental health services in the year prior to death. Their next-of-kin were invited to participate in the study and subsequently to nominate other key informants.

Type.evidence_source: Our data are drawn from a qualitative study of 14 cases of completed suicide conducted in 2008e9 (Owens et al., 2009, 2011).

Area.evidence_source: The circumstances of the suicide were reconstructed using a narrative-based interview method. A single opening question, inviting the participant to tell the story of what happened, was used to elicit the participant's unique account of the suicide process from their point of view.
